messages.author: acb2ff650a985928
messages.subject: HTTP Server Error
parts:
Apologies for the novice knowledge. 

I'm trying to access sudo shiny-server, however I get the following:

[2013-09-24 17:40:12.828] [INFO] shiny-server - Shiny Server v0.3.6 (Node.js v0.10.18)
[2013-09-24 17:40:12.830] [INFO] shiny-server - Using config file "/usr/lib/node_modules/shiny-server/config/default.config"
[2013-09-24 17:40:12.870] [INFO] shiny-server - Starting listener on 0.0.0.0:3838
[2013-09-24 17:40:12.875] [ERROR] shiny-server - HTTP server error (0.0.0.0:3838): listen EADDRINUSE
[2013-09-24 17:40:12.876] [INFO] shiny-server - Shutting down worker processes

I'm running on Digital Ocean, I noticed a few people were on Amazon and having a similar issue. What command can I do to fix this?

Any help is much appreciated!

messages.subject: Re: HTTP Server Error
